title: Real-door Go test for the hosted claude-sub step-down
description:
The step-down is covered by the parity guard (static) and by a fake httptest door on the Go side, but no test drives the real door through it. A scratch test confirmed it works: hosted harness, fill MAX1's cap with two claude/sonnet starts, and the third start comes back as pi-durable/workers-ai/@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3 and is accepted by the real executor. Commit it beside TestTheRealDoorRunsAClaudeSubJobOnAHostedDeployment, asserting the handle, the record, one agent started, and no new lease. Lowering the cap through a harness binding (CLAUDE_SUB_MAX_CONCURRENT=1) would keep it to two starts.
evidence: internal/exec/cloudflaresandbox/claude_sub_e2e_test.go (leased path only); internal/exec/cloudflaresandbox/model_test.go TestASteppedDownRungDispatchStartsAndRecordsThePairThatRan (fake door)
